# Fiat Ducato workshop manual (text version)

> Official eLearn workshop manual for the Fiat Ducato, English. Engines: 2.0 16V, 2.0 JTD 8V, 2.3 JTD 16V, 2.8 JTD 8V. Production periods: da 03/05, fino a 02/05. Each topic is a separate HTML page with its path, applicability, and links to and from related topics.

Start with the guide, then follow links. Use the lookups to jump from a component, fuse or operation code to its pages.

## Start here
- [Guide: how the manual is organised, code systems, wire colours](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/guide.html)
- [Component index: component -> pinouts, replacement procedures, references](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/lookup/components.html)
- [Fuse and relay index: rating, junction unit and every circuit that names it](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/lookup/fuses.html)
- [Operation index: operation or test code -> topic](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/lookup/operations.html)
- [All sections](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/index.html)

## Sections
- [Technical Data](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/t/244000000.html): technical data / specifications
- [Descriptions](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/t/244000359.html): system description
- [Fault diagnosis](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/t/244000442.html): fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- [Test](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/t/244000524.html): test / check procedure
- [Procedures](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/t/244000595.html): repair procedure (removal / refitting; the operation number is the code)
- [Electrical equipment](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/t/244001572.html): 

## Background notes
- [data-model.md](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/notes/data-model.md): wire colour codes, connector-body colours, how pinouts describe every wire, what only the diagrams add
- [rendering-rules.md](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDct/en/ai/notes/rendering-rules.md): how the manual is structured: Removing/Refitting parts, Op. calls between procedures, variants
